phase_name: Extend the Advisory Over the New Token

objectives.description: Parameterize the check over a CFD_TOKENS array
Add CORPUS-UNVERIFIED to the token list
Extend the promotion-criterion comment to cover both tokens
Add fixtures for the new token in both directions plus mention-suppression
Confirm existing token's fixtures still pass unchanged

notes: Converted the Phase 1 single-token check into a `for _cfd_token in "${CFD_TOKENS[@]}"` loop over CFD_TOKENS=("CARRIED-UNVERIFIED" "CORPUS-UNVERIFIED"); the flattening/mention-suppression/bounded-window awk body is unchanged, only parameterized by the loop variable already used for the awk -v token=. Extended the header comment block to explain both tokens' shared mechanical surface and updated the promotion-criterion comment to say 'either condition, for either token'. Added 13 new test cases (CORPUS-UNVERIFIED WF/MF for report and plan, a mention-suppression case, plus 2 explicit post-parameterization re-checks of the original CARRIED-UNVERIFIED cases) and generalized assert_cfd_silent's grep pattern to match either token's 'mark(s)' message. Full suite: 121 PASSED, 0 FAILED (up from 108 before this phase). bash -n and shellcheck both clean on validate-artifact.sh (same 3 pre-existing info-level findings as Phase 1, no new ones) and on test-validate-artifact.sh (same info-level SC1091/SC2016 pattern, one additional SC2016 hit at the new cfd_corpus_mention line, same class as pre-existing ones). Real-corpus sweep for CORPUS-UNVERIFIED across every file under specs/*/reports/ and specs/*/plans/: zero occurrences, as expected since the token does not yet exist in any artifact.
